title: refactor: pass requests intact to background generation
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Passes all request headers and body fields to our background worker without an allowlist or replay-time credential stripping. Stored jobs can therefore contain caller credentials.
- Keeps credentials out of cache identity and leaves provider header construction separate. Excludes the Pollinations JSON key at the final Chat Completions provider boundary.
- Preserves adapted requests and multipart files; tests raw JSON/binary bodies and custom headers.
- Extracted from the discussion on #14815 so new request headers do not require deduplication changes. Verified 239 targeted tests, formatting, and Gen type-checking.

gist.headline: Requests keep their luggage
gist.blurb: Background generation now carries the whole request along instead of unpacking it at the door. Custom headers, adapted payloads, and multipart files can make the trip intact.
gist.summary: Background generation now forwards complete request headers and bodies—including custom headers, raw JSON or binary payloads, adapted requests, and multipart files—while keeping cache identity and provider-header construction separate.
gist.impact: Developers can use new request headers and richer payload formats with background jobs without needing deduplication changes, while Pollinations JSON credentials remain excluded at the final Chat Completions provider boundary.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy mailroom-garden scene represents a background worker receiving sealed request parcels intact: custom-header envelopes, a JSON scroll, and a multipart file crate travel along a vine-lined conveyor toward a softly glowing retro terminal. Polli, wearing a tiny postal cap, carefully escorts the complete bundle while a CRT monitor robot checks the destination label; the separate cache shelf stays neatly organized nearby.
